name: 打工水豚
intro: 一只系着领带的水豚，每天准时上班，准时不想上班。
style: thick clean dark outlines, flat colors

stickers.caption: 收到
stickers.action: nods twice and gives a big thumbs up

stickers.caption: 不想上班
stickers.action: bursts into huge cartoon tears, shaking, then calms a little

stickers.caption: 摸鱼中
